'''Mining Way''' was an avenue that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Xakrea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. The avenue branched out from the city's central plaza, and was the site of a number of processing plants. The [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] statue ''[[Daiman at Chelloa]]'' faced in the direction of Mining Way.
